title: Simple Greeting Function
description: Define and call a function that prints a greeting message.
constraints: Define a function named greet_user with void return type and no parameters. Call it from main.
explanation: For the given input, the output is the required greeting message.

title: Calculate Area of a Rectangle
description: Write a function that takes the length and width of a rectangle as input and returns its area.
constraints: Define a function named calculate_rectangle_area that takes two double parameters and returns a double. Read input for length and width using cin.
explanation: For the given input values of length and width, the output is their product formatted to two decimal places.

title: Display Current Score
description: Write a function that takes an integer score as input and prints it. Call it twice with different values.
constraints: Define a function named display_score that takes an int parameter and returns void. Read two integers and call the function for each.
explanation: For each input value, the output is printed in the specified format.

title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Write a function that converts a temperature value from Celsius to Fahrenheit and prints the result.
constraints: Define a function named celsius_to_fahrenheit that takes a double and returns a double. Read input using cin.
explanation: For the input Celsius value, the output is the corresponding Fahrenheit value formatted to one decimal place.

title: Pass by Reference: Swap Two Numbers
description: Write a function that swaps two numbers using pass-by-reference.
constraints: Define a function swap_numbers that takes two int reference parameters. Read two integers and call the function.
explanation: After swapping, the output shows the values in swapped order.

title: Overloaded print_value Function
description: Write three overloaded functions named print_value that print an int, a double (fixed, two decimals), or a string.
constraints: Define three overloaded functions print_value(int), print_value(double), print_value(const string&). Read one int, one double, one string, and call the respective function.
sampleOutput:
Integer value: 10
Double value: 3.14
String value: Hello Overload!
explanation: Each input value is printed by its corresponding overloaded function with formatting as specified.

title: Calculate Circle Properties with Default Arguments
description: Write a function that prints the area and optionally the circumference of a circle, using a default argument.
constraints: Define a function calculate_circle_properties(double, bool = false). Read input for radius and a boolean (0 or 1) for the default argument.
explanation: For each radius and flag, the output is the area and optionally the circumference formatted to two decimals.

title: Recursive Sum of Digits
description: Write a recursive function that returns the sum of the digits of a non-negative integer.
constraints: Define a recursive function sum_digits that takes an int and returns an int. Read input using cin.
explanation: The output is the sum of all digits in the input integer.

title: Passing Arrays to Functions: Calculate Average
description: Write a function that calculates the average of an array of integers.
constraints: Define a function double calculate_average(const int[], int). Read the size and elements of the array.
explanation: The output is the average of the array elements formatted to two decimals.

title: Function Pointers for Strategy Pattern
description: Use function pointers to perform an arithmetic operation selected by the user.
constraints: Define functions for add, subtract, multiply, and a perform_operation accepting a function pointer. Read user choice and operands.
explanation: The output is the result of the chosen arithmetic operation on the operands.

title: Static Local Variables and Function State
description: Write a function that generates a unique ID each time it is called, using a static local variable.
constraints: Define a function generate_unique_id with a static variable. Call it five times and print the result each time.
explanation: The output is five increasing unique IDs, one per line.

title: Customer Loyalty Program Points Calculator
description: Write overloaded functions that calculate loyalty points based on amount, with optional flat or multiplier bonuses.
constraints: Define four overloaded functions named calculate_loyalty_points. Read input for each case and print the result.
explanation: Each output is the calculated points for the corresponding input, using the overloaded function.
